config firewall address
edit "Prefix-multi.example.com-1_1_1_1"
set subnet 1.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
set comment "Resolved from multi.example.com | ip=1.1.1.1 | resolved_at=2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
next

edit "Prefix-multi.example.com-2_2_2_2"
set subnet 2.2.2.2 255.255.255.255
set comment "Resolved from multi.example.com | ip=2.2.2.2 | resolved_at=2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-multi.example.com-Group"
set member "Prefix-multi.example.com-1_1_1_1" "Prefix-multi.example.com-2_2_2_2"
next

edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-multi.example.com-1_1_1_1" "Prefix-multi.example.com-2_2_2_2"
next

end
